english.title: Use on a road a pedal cycle when the front / rear lamps / retro reflectors were not clean / in good working order
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) used on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a pedal cycle on which not every

(A)_[front position lamp was clean and in good working order]_
(B)_[rear position lamp was clean and in good working order]_
(C)_[rear retro reflector was in good working order]_
(D)_[pedal retro reflector was in good working order]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 23(1) of the Road Vehicles Lighting Regulations 1989 and section 91 of the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Regulation 4(3) states that lamps need not be fitted between sunrise and sunset.
(ii) See regulation 23(3) for exceptions.
(iii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iv) See also offence wordings: H3395, H3396, H3397, H3398 and H3399.
(v) Fixed penalty scheme may be applied
